Sanjana Verma
Senior Frontend Engineer | Remote (India)
sanjana.verma425@example.com | +91 9253794549

Experienced frontend engineer focusing on delivering robust, accessible, and high-performance web applications. Strong track record of shipping production features in fintech and e-commerce environments, collaborating with design and backend teams to improve user metrics and reduce production defects. Available with a 60 days notice period.

Experience
Saffron Bank, Oct 2024 - Apr 2026
Senior Frontend Engineer — Remote
- Led implementation of a secure customer dashboard using TypeScript and React, improving page load performance by 35% and reducing client-side errors by 42% through strict typing and runtime checks.
- Built a reusable component library for internal banking flows, increasing development velocity by 25% and cutting visual regression test surface using Jest for unit tests.
- Collaborated with backend and security teams to integrate token refresh and client-side validation, reducing authentication-related support tickets by 30%.
- Owned Jira sprint planning and Confluence documentation for frontend onboarding, reducing new-hire ramp time by two weeks.

Nykaa, Nov 2021 - Sep 2024
React Developer — Remote
- Developed high-traffic e-commerce product pages with React and Redux, enabling dynamic merchandising that increased conversion rate by 12% on targeted cohorts.
- Implemented responsive layouts and component-level styling with CSS, improving mobile engagement time by 18% and reducing layout thrashing.
- Wrote comprehensive unit and integration tests with Jest, raising test coverage for core checkout flows to 88% and preventing regressions during major releases.
- Coordinated cross-functional feature launches via Jira and documented release notes on Confluence to streamline stakeholder communication.

Capgemini, Jun 2019 - Oct 2021
UI Engineer — Remote
- Delivered enterprise dashboards and internal tools using TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, improving developer consistency and reducing CSS bundle size by 20%.
- Built and maintained component test suites with Jest, catching critical UI bugs in pre-production and improving stability for client demos.
- Worked in Linux-based CI environments to automate builds and deployments, cutting manual deployment time by 60%.
- Maintained sprint artifacts in Jira and authored UI guidelines in Confluence to ensure consistent design implementation across teams.

Projects
- Design System Cleanup: Refactored a shared component library to TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, migrated 45 components, and decreased duplication by 70%.
- Automated Test Suite Expansion: Grew Jest test suites for a customer-facing app from 40% to 85% coverage, resulting in a 50% drop in production hotfixes.

Skills
Languages: TypeScript
Frameworks & Libraries: React, Redux
Testing & Tooling: Jest, Jira
Styling & CSS: CSS, Tailwind CSS
Other: Linux, Confluence

Education
M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad

Notice period: 60 days
